method: Visual reading of three user-supplied Figma screenshots in the conversation, cross-checked against previously archived node dimensions, tokens and property samples; no new Figma request.

images.visibleVariants: Chip five appearances in L/M/S, Dialog, Link Default/Active/Hover, Breadcrumbs

observations: Option text is Regular, with transparent default/hover/disabled, a blue hover outline and blue pressed/selected fills.
Multi-switch has no overall border or fill. It keeps 4 px inner padding and 4 px gaps; children hug their labels.
Chip and Alert use source semantic colors and three distinct circle glyphs: information, check, exclamation.
Chip close marks are much smaller than their leading circle icons, particularly in M/S.
Alert L combines a 20 px leading circle and a 24 px close slot; using 24 px for both incorrectly wraps the reference sentence.
Dialog has equal-width actions across its content width with a 12 px gap, 16 px vertical section gaps and a subtle source shadow.
Link is gray by default, black when active and blue on hover, without persistent underlining. Breadcrumbs use a real chevron vector.
measurements: Native component metrics and corrections are recorded in design/secondary-components-rules.json. Screenshot scales are approximate; cached Figma dimensions take precedence.
limitations: Original attachment bytes are not available as local files. No PNG checksum or automated source-image pixel diff is claimed.
Detailed per-variant Figma contexts and dedicated P2 SVG exports remain incomplete.
Browser images in artifacts/p2-correction-2026-10-22 are implementation evidence, not original Figma screenshots.
